summary: TRACK 25 SPRINT 1 — AdminOS canonical landing verified. All 10 domain cards render with correct data-testids and live probe data; posture strip counts correct (Healthy=4, Attention=2, Critical=3, Wiring=1, Total=10); Maintenance card shows NEEDS WIRING as required; Storage & Recovery shows numeric backup age (7.6m · 91 archives), no '[object Object]'; SideNavV3 present; Refresh button works; legacy /admin/hub_v1 and /admin/hub_v2 immediately redirect to /admin and AdminOS renders; all 10 canonical target routes load content with testids and are not 404. critical_code_review_comments: AdminOS.jsx is well-scoped (~740 lines) and self-contained; domain configuration is declarative and easy to extend for Sprint 2.
The `probe()` helper swallows non-2xx bodies (returns body=null). This means server-provided error JSON is not surfaced for debugging; acceptable for a status dashboard but worth noting.

Governance card computes `metric` as `${Math.round(score*100)}%` even when score=0 with 38 highs — semantically the 0% and CRITICAL badge together are correct (live truth), just visually can confuse operators. Consider annotating that '0%' is the convergence score.
